title: pi-marimo
body: A live marimo notebook beside Pi's chat. Keys pressed appear below the window.

title: /marimo edit demo.py
body: Starts a marimo server and docks the notebook beside the chat. No browser.

title: A A  ·  run all
body: Every cell runs. Stat cards, tables and live Plotly charts render in the terminal.

title: a  ·  ask the agent
body: It edits the notebook through marimo pair; the cells it touches are marked as it works.

title: The agent sees its chart
body: marimo_chart shows the chart in the chat and hands the agent its picture.

title: w  ·  drive widgets
body: Move the slider from the keyboard; the chart reruns.

title: t  ·  tables
body: Page, sort and select rows. Space selects days, and the chart marks them.

title: c  ·  the agent's changes
body: Jump between the cells the agent touched: one new, one changed.

title: d  ·  the diff
body: See exactly what the agent rewrote, and which cells rerun.

title: u  ·  undo
body: Revert and run puts the cell back as it was.
